caption: The drawing features two main objects. At the top part of the composition, there is an outline drawing of a cylindrical container, such as a stoneware crock, shown in black line. The container has two handles on its sides and a label with text, as well as a large number “2” and a blue decorative swirl pattern beneath the number. Below the container, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the composition, there is a larger, detailed rendering of the same blue swirl pattern, painted with watercolor-like strokes in various shades of blue on a brownish-gray background. The swirls are thick and tubular, intertwining in a loose arrangement, closely resembling the blue pattern depicted on the container above. The overall color palette is muted, primarily using blue, brown, and gray tones.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
